Current: 2025-26 Kuwait Emir Cup

The Kuwait Amir/Emir Cup (Arabic: كأس أمير الكويت) is a Kuwaiti football competition created in 1962. The Emir Cup is the last football competition in the Kuwaiti football season calendar.

Al-Arabi hold the record of being the only team to reach the final 11 consecutive times, from 1962 up to 1972.
